statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes submitted are G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The service is appropriate given the patient's history of transient neurological deficits and the need to identify an underlying arrhythmic source
